about.title: About Me
about.p1: I am a junior-year student at Changchun University, majoring in Electrical Engineering and Automation, with a focus on robotics systems and embedded development. I am passionate about writing efficient, reliable code for resource-constrained hardware, with hands-on project experience from STM32 microcontrollers to embedded Linux systems.
about.p2: My tech stack covers C/C++, Linux driver development, ROS2 robotics framework, STM32 and Cortex-M architectures, and common industrial communication protocols (UART, I2C, SPI, SocketCAN, EtherCAT). I enjoy the full-stack embedded development process from hardware to low-level drivers.
about.p3: Outside of coursework, I actively participate in engineering competitions and open-source projects. I believe technology grows through sharing and collaboration, and I am committed to open-sourcing my work and learning alongside the community.
